test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Her __austere__ lifestyle reflected her minimalist approach to living.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"austere"** means severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance. (सख्त या कठोर)
 
 
• **Example:** The monk led an austere life with no luxuries and minimal possessions.
 
 
 
• **"Sombre"** refers to something that is dark or dull in color or tone; gloomy. (उदास या गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example:** The mood at the funeral was sombre and reflective.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'austere'** is **'sombre'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Luxurious** (शानदार): Extremely comfortable, elegant, or enjoyable, especially in a way that involves great expense.
 
 
• **Example:** They stayed in a luxurious hotel during their vacation.
 
 
 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt happy after receiving the good news.
 
 
 
• **Giddy** (चक्करदार): Having a sensation of whirling and a tendency to fall or stagger; dizzy.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt giddy after riding the roller coaster.
 
 

41:Tb58,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.</
